title: Potato Far Lands
description: This is a fabric mod that adds the Far Lands into the Poisonous Potato April Fools Snapshot
body:
**What does this Mod do?**

This mod brings back the Far Lands to the Poisonous Potato Update
 
  **How can you reach them?**

Either you walk 12550821 blocks , or you use /tp 12550821

 **Credits:**

Indigo227: Scripting , Infa65: Making the Icon
